_description: Offline NVD-style vulnerability dictionary keyed by service name + version range. Small mock subset for local dev/QA only. In a production build this would be refreshed from the real NVD JSON feeds, but that is outside this project's local test-lab scope.

entries.summary: Username enumeration via crafted authentication packets.
Local privilege escalation via scoreboard manipulation in the MPM worker/event modules.
mod_copy allows unauthenticated remote arbitrary file copy.
HTTP/2 flood ('Data Dribble') can exhaust CPU resources (DoS).
Buffer overflow in the WebDAV service (ScStoragePathFromUrl) allows remote code execution.
Backdoor command execution triggered by a crafted username string.
